te: Indonesia threatens Singapore with power outage after gas dispute
de: The energy dispute between Indonesia and Singapore has taken a new turn. After cutting natural gas supplies, Jakarta warned it could refuse to export electricity to a neighbouring state if the parties were to cut back on the supply…

t: Рыбак закинул удочку и стал миллионером
d: В Австралии мужчина, сам того не зная, принял участие в рыболовном соревновании и выиграл миллион долларов, пишет The Guardian.
te: The fisherman threw a fishing rod and became a millionaire
de: In Australia, a man, unknowingly, took part in a fishing competition and won a million dollars, writes The Guardian.
